new.title: Full-scale mixed convection is not qualified
new.finding: Both reconstructions extrapolate the sphere forced-convection fit beyond its source Re interval. The inherited 1.32 floor lacks a documented sphere size/orientation validity range.
new.needed: Measure local mixed convection or establish a validated full-size flow/thermal model; retain both explicit convection rows.

new.title: Bonded sandwich conductance and core-gap radiation
new.finding: Solid-metal conduction, adhesive contact resistance and core-cell radiation are distinct. Neither zero resistance nor effective gap emissivity .20 is a measured installed value.
new.needed: Measure CR-III/AF163/Be conductance with actual cure, contact area, coating and evacuated cells; retain the zero/.20 gap alternatives.

new.title: Installed multilayer CCAg/ITO optical pair
new.finding: The .09/.80 pair is a class-level transfer, not the exact deposited recipe on Be after terrestrial weathering or wetting.
new.needed: Measure hemispherical emittance and solar absorptance for the actual treated Be, thickness, ITO, edge and aging state.

new.title: Steady thermal boundary versus actual operation
new.finding: Zenith sun, fixed sky/ground temperatures and 2 m/s flow define two equilibria. The optimistic weather changes buoyancy and pressure but not the thermal boundary.
new.needed: Specify joint sunlight, wind direction/speed, ambient/sky/ground histories, thermal inertia, precipitation and allowed operating states.

new.title: Inner enclosure emissivity and obstructions
new.finding: Uniform .20 emissivity and an empty diffuse sphere produce an exact view-factor identity for that geometry; equipment, frames, seams and actual inner finish are absent.
new.needed: Measure the inner surface and model obstructions/view factors before assigning installed cavity heat exchange.

new.title: Lateral heat flow and structural temperature projection
new.finding: The face/core solve omits lateral heat flow and keeps only temperature harmonics 2–6 for bending. Pole and mean-projection errors are corrected, but a physical truncation bound is absent.
new.needed: Resolve lateral conduction, seams and required spatial/temporal load spectrum; validate structural response to the resulting field.

new.title: 200 F process and compliant-core bond interpretation
new.finding: The stress-free cure reference, compliant in-plane core, free-edge transfer and foil yield proxy are conditional. Existing tests do not qualify the precise 2U .015/Be/honeycomb assembly.
new.needed: Retain the inherited 037b and CHECK-040 qualification rows and test the intended assembly/process, including edge/scarf coincidence and peel.

new.title: Cure compression in global/crimp demand
new.finding: Both the original exclusion and subsequent inclusion of balanced cure compression are carried. No installed nonlinear structural qualification selects one by fiat.
new.needed: Use the cure-inclusive branch for the conservative scalar comparison and validate equilibrium/prestress/load redistribution for the built hull.

new.title: Exterior retention, moisture and wet optics
new.finding: The 0.1 kg/m2 external water debit and material drying assumptions remain projections. Thermal reconciliation does not establish a dry-exterior operational limit or permit removing those masses.
new.needed: Measure retention/conditioning and wet optical performance; preserve all existing debit and equipment qualifications.
